newsitem.title: USA: MFRI Thermal Care acquisition completed.
newsitem.headline: MFRI Thermal Care acquisition completed.

text.p: MFRI Inc said Tuesday it completed the acquisition of the Thermal Care business and certain assets and liabilities of Midwesco Inc.
The deal also included a merger of Midwesco into MFRI. Previously Midwesco had held a 38 percent stake of MFRI.

As previously reported, about 2.1 million shares of MFRI common stock were issued to the shareholders of Midwesco in the merger. However, 1,717,666 shares of MFRI stock that had been owned by Midwesco were cancelled in the merger.
This resulted in a net increase in shares outstanding of about 406,600 shares.
Thermal Care engineers, designs and manufactures industrial water cooling equipment. In the year ended January 31, Thermal Care had net sales of approximately $20 million.
MFRI makes and sells filter bags for use in industrial air pollution control systems.
